name: Peoria, Arizona (United States, 1954–2017)
description: A white field with the blue circular seal of the City of Peoria, showing a sunrise over fields with the date 1954, in the centre.
history: The seal-on-white flag used by Peoria from its incorporation on 7 June 1954 until a new flag was adopted in 2017.

features.role: seal of the City of Peoria
